scientific_integrity: Critical-normal-form cancellation is proved algebraically for all stated parameter values; exact and numerical example checks are supporting checks, not a substitute for proof. No independent validation asserted.
scientific_limitations: First Lyapunov vanishing does not determine fifth-order criticality for unbalanced groups, limit cycles away from the critical parameter, or global attraction. The symmetric-majority center is local. Exact dynamics apply to the deterministic well-mixed model. Independent audit is not performed.
title: Degenerate Hopf criticality and exact nonlinear centers in collective-risk games
